resources.string: Ba a iya aika rahoton ba. Ka sake gwadawa daga baya.
Ƙididdigar shigarwa ba tare da suna ba
SP-DECODE tana ƙidaya kimanin shigarwa masu aiki sau ɗaya a rana don tsara ƙarfin sabar. Ana amfani da lambar shigarwa ta bazata, ba Android ID ɗinka ba, ko HWID ko ID ɗin talla.
Ana haɗa wannan da amfani da Cloud bayan ka karɓi sharuɗɗan sirri. Ba a haɗa abubuwan fayiloli, kalmomin sirri ko tsare-tsaren da aka warware ba.
